WES of two NOA brothers, two POI sisters and parents; AF>1% exclusion gives2172, protein-sequence filter702, next box141 with no separately labelled transition, biallelic LoF/deleterious missense67, testis/ovary expression5, gametogenesis SPATA22 stopgain. limitations: Four related siblings provide one consanguineous family, not four independent families.
Nonsense allele is predicted to truncate MEIOB-binding domain; this study does not directly quantify endogenous SPATA22 protein or demonstrate variant-specific rescue.
Biopsy and meiotic assays are from IV-3 only; they do not directly measure ovarian meiosis or IV-4 testis.
Splice minigene and10x phasing concern a separate sporadic woman with different alleles, not these mapped siblings.
Sisters had prior pregnancies and no amenorrhea at assessment; source calls biochemical POI, not complete lifelong loss of fertility.

patient_identity.statement: Selected subject ID concatenates IV-2 and IV-1, two distinct sisters; age14 menstrual onset corresponds IV-1, whereas IV-2 onset is13. Cannot assign this combined packet to exactly one woman.
limitations: No frozen identity alteration; do not count merged and separate sister packets as independent people.

genotype.statement: Homozygous SPATA22 c.400C>T,p.Arg134Ter in all four siblings, Sanger confirmed.

segregation.statement: Both first-cousin parents heterozygous; all four affected siblings homozygous.
limitations: Figure1 pedigree labels motherIII-1/fatherIII-2, while chromatogram labels reverse parental numbers; both parental carrier genotypes remain supported.

phase.statement: Homozygous allele with both parents heterozygous supports one copy from each parent; no compound-heterozygous phasing inference needed.
